hook: YOU *HATE WHAT YOU SEE IN THE *MIRROR
title: F17 · mirror · The Mirror
lines: She has been in front of the mirror for twenty minutes.
The filter on her phone knows a prettier girl.
She wishes she could send that one to the party.
She sat down on the edge of the bath, and decided not to go.
the mirror was full of the strangest wedding party she had ever seen.
Every odd, unlovely creature in the world.
And the groom had left out none of them.
She wiped the steam off the glass, and they went with it.
She went to the party as herself.
He takes you as you are. Start by doing the same. That is sadhana.
